title: Q-BLIND-name-clearance-eu-wipo: close the ip blind spot name-clearance-eu-wipo
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every blindspots scan
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation blindspots --closed name-clearance-eu-wipo
**Prediction:** blindspots_open <= 6 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

Why the owner would not know to ask: The name search covered the US register only; EUIPO, WIPO Madrid and UKIPO were not reachable from the session that ran it (found by the 2026-11-20 ip sweep).
Action: search EUIPO eSearch, WIPO Global Brand Database and UKIPO for ULTRASTABLE in classes 9 and 42, add rows to searched and empty unsearched. The probe in doctrine/blindspots.json passes when it is done.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.6 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
